question.problem:
The vectors ${a}_{1}$, ${a}_{2}$, ${a}_{3}$, and $b$ are given below. Determine if $b\in \text{Span}\{{a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3}\}.$ In the affirmative case, find the value of ${x}_{1}\cdot {x}_{2}\cdot {x}_{3}$ from the decomposition $b={x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}.$

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 4 \\ 2\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ -8 \\ -3\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 18 \\ 9\end{aligned}]
$$
question.worked_solution:
We know that $b\in \text{Span}\{{a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3}\}$ if there exist ${x}_{1}$, ${x}_{2}$ and ${x}_{3}$ such that 

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3} & =b \\ {x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 4 \\ 2\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ -8 \\ -3\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 18 \\ 9\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

So, we have the following system of equations:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-2{x}_{3}=3 \\ 4{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}-8{x}_{3}=18 \\ 2{x}_{1}-3{x}_{3}=9\end{aligned}
$$

To solve the system above, we set up and row reduce an augmented matrix:

$$
\begin{aligned} & [\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & -2 & 3 \\ 4 & 1 & -8 & 18 \\ 2 & 0 & -3 & 9\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}-4{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & -2 & 3 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 6 \\ 2 & 0 & -3 & 9\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & -2 & 3 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 6 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 3\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we have the system

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-2{x}_{3}=3 \\ {x}_{2}=6 \\ {x}_{3}=3.\end{aligned}
$$

From the third equation, we get ${x}_{3}=3.$ Substituting into the first equation gives 

$$
{x}_{1}-2(3)=3\,⟹\,{x}_{1}=9.
$$

Since the system has a solution, we can conclude that $b\in \text{Span}\{{a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3}\}.$

Moreover, there is exactly one solution, so we have exactly one way to write $b$ as a linear combination of ${a}_{1}$, ${a}_{2}$ and ${a}_{3}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}9{a}_{1}+6{a}_{2}+3{a}_{3} & =b \\ 9\cdot [\begin{aligned}1 \\ 4 \\ 2\end{aligned}]+6\cdot [\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+3\cdot [\begin{aligned}-2 \\ -8 \\ -3\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 18 \\ 9\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, ${x}_{1}\cdot {x}_{2}\cdot {x}_{3}=9\cdot 6\cdot 3=162.$
